messages.subject: WITHOUT PREJUDICE - Hale settlement agreement (first draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Bartlett,

Further to our call, please find attached the first draft of the settlement agreement reflecting the terms discussed: PILON of £92,500, accrued holiday of £7,115 and an ex gratia payment of £100,000, with an agreed reference at Schedule 2 and the adviser's certificate at Schedule 1. We've assumed the claim will be withdrawn within 7 days of the agreement taking effect.

Grateful for your client's comments.
